mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dream_content (id, user_id, title, content, emotion, place, time, interpretation, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{emotion}, #{place}, #{time}, #{interpretation}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, title, content, emotion, place, time, interpretation, created_at as createdAt FROM dream_content WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
